what: User decision (2026-10-20): where Taprats' Java sort would throw "Comparison method violates its general contract!", the port's faithful sort reports it as data. PlanarMap.transform/2, replicate/3 and weld/2 return {:ok, …} | {:error, :inconsistent_order}, each with a bang twin (transform!/2, replicate!/3, weld!/2) that raises ArgumentError. Figure builders in Plans 3–5 use the bang twins. scale/2 and translate/3 never sort, so they stay bare.
why: The AGENTS.md hard rule says a Java throw maps to an error tuple; the input that triggers it (near-coincident geometry) is caller-supplied.
